candidate.verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address

Hi {0},

candidate.resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
candidate.resetPassword.body:
A request was made to reset the password of your candidate account.

Choose a new password

This link expires in 1 hour and can be used once. If you did not request this, ignore this email — your current password still works.
candidate.passwordReset.subject: Your password was reset
candidate.passwordReset.body:
The password of your candidate account was just reset, and every signed-in session was ended.

If you did this, no action is needed — sign in with your new password.

If you did not, someone else may have access to your email — please contact us immediately.
